page.overview:
Who is Saurian?

The Saurian wears a brown, loose-fitting jumpsuit, as well as an iron chest-plate that has an appearance similar to a medieval chest-plate. His mouth is guarded by a iron mouthpiece, similar to the design of the lower half of Reptile's mouth guard. His skin has a reddish-brown, scaly texture to it and his head has a ridge of short spikes.

In Update 2.0 of Mortal Kombat Mobile, the Saurian's scales on his face and body are more detailed than before with the colors and appearance being more bright and detailed. Additionally, his mouth and jaw's colors are changed from black to grey. His armor is much more metallic than his original appearance and gains a more detailed appearance with new textures.
